business_summary: Mega Genomics Limited, a genetic testing platform company, offers consumer genetic testing and cancer screening services in China. It offers brain health assessment package, a service that assesses the risk of various related diseases, including Alzheimer's disease; alimentation capability assessment package, a service that assesses the risk of developing hyperhomocysteinemia; Parkinson's disease risk assessment; full-scale cancer risk assessment packages; myocardial infarction and heart failure genetic testing; cardiovascular and cerebrovascular disease risk assessment packages; hereditary breast cancer/ovarian cancer genetic testing; Septin9 colorectal cancer screening test; RNF180/Septin9 gastric cancer screening test; cervical cancer genetic methylation testing, a cervical cancer test; telomere length genetic testing; and personal whole genome test plus, a service that assesses the risk of developing multiple types of diseases and provides interpretation for various individual traits and medication advice. It also offers whole exome sequencing package for adults, a service that assesses the risk of developing multiple high-risk diseases, hereditary cancers, recessive genetic diseases, and types of complex diseases, as well as multiple drugs, dietary nutrition items, and exercise and fitness items; folate metabolic capacity assessment testing kits to assess the risk of developing cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases; ApoE gene testing for testing Alzheimer's disease; BRCA1/2 gene mutation testing kits; Alzheimer's disease screening kits; colorectal cancer screening kits; gastric cancer screening kits; lung nodule auxiliary diagnostic kits; and cervical cancer screening kits to health checkup centers and hospitals. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
business_summary_ko: 유전자 검사 플랫폼 회사인 Mega Genomics Limited는 중국에서 소비자 유전자 검사 및 암 검진 서비스를 제공합니다. 알츠하이머병을 포함한 다양한 관련 질병의 위험을 평가하는 서비스인 뇌 건강 평가 패키지를 제공합니다. 고호모시스테인혈증 발생 위험을 평가하는 서비스인 영양 능력 평가 패키지; 파킨슨병 위험 평가; 본격적인 암 위험 평가 패키지; 심근경색 및 심부전 유전자 검사; 심혈관 및 뇌혈관 질환 위험 평가 패키지; 유전성 유방암/난소암 유전자 검사; Septin9 대장암 선별검사; RNF180/Septin9 위암 선별검사; 자궁경부암 유전자 메틸화 검사, 자궁경부암 검사; 텔로미어 길이 유전자 검사; 개인 전체 게놈 테스트 플러스(Personal Whole Genome Test Plus)는 다양한 유형의 질병 발병 위험을 평가하고 다양한 개인 특성에 대한 해석과 약물 조언을 제공하는 서비스입니다. 또한 성인을 위한 전체 엑솜 시퀀싱 패키지를 제공합니다. 이는 여러 고위험 질병, 유전성 암, 열성 유전 질환의 발병 위험을 평가하는 서비스입니다.
